plan.selection: Fixed3 medians, cyclic arm order; all observations retained, no threshold-based repeat or pooling.

time_scope: CoreMark validated100000 iteration guest loop; all other elapsed times include fresh process/startup/JIT/teardown and same wrapper.
pmu_scope: Inherited user group on launch-wrapper PID plus descendants; live child ancestry/affinity when captured. Private FEXServer outside measured tree.

sampling_limit: Fixed three-observation medians, all samples/ranges retained. No fastest selection or pooling with prior dates; not a significance or full-ISA claim.
